dependencies.statement:
In the regime of @lem-disk-perturbation, for every prevertex arc $I$ corresponding to a straight effective edge, the disk normal derivative $p=-\partial_rv|_{\partial\mathbb D}$ satisfies
$$
\operatorname{osc}_I p
\le C S^{3/4}\sqrt{\log(e/S)}.
$$
Moreover $p\ge p_D/2$ on the boundary for sufficiently small $S$.
Also, for sufficiently small $S$,
$$
\|p-p_D\|_{L^\infty(\partial\mathbb D)}\le C\sqrt S+CS,
$$
so $p\le2p_D$.
dependencies.title: Uniform disk pressure oscillation

dependencies.statement:
Let $h>0$ be monotone on $[0,\varepsilon]$. Define the normalized physical coordinate
$$
x(s)=\frac{\int_0^s h(t)dt}{\int_0^\varepsilon h(t)dt},
\qquad \widetilde k_0(x)=h(s(x))^{-2}.
$$
Suppose $p_0>0$ and $p_0\le p(s(x))\le C_0p_0$ for a fixed $C_0$ and
$$
\int_0^1(x-1/2)p(s(x))^2\widetilde k_0(x)dx=0.
$$
Then
$$
D:=\frac{\int_{s<t}(h(s)/h(t)-h(t)/h(s))dsdt}
{\int_{s<t}(h(s)/h(t)+h(t)/h(s))dsdt}
\le C\frac{\operatorname{osc}p}{p_0}.
$$
dependencies.title: Monotone weight double-integral comparison

dependencies.statement:
Let $P$ be admissible and stationary in the senses of @def-admissible-polygon and @def-stationary-polygon, let $E$ be an effective edge, and use the normalized conformal data in @def-conformal-data. Under @lem-edge-moments, let $p=-\partial_rv|_{\partial\mathbb D}$, $h=|F'|$, and normalize $E$ by physical arclength $x\in[0,1]$. Then
$$
q(x)=p(\theta(x))^2h(\theta(x))^{-2},
$$
and, with $k_0=h^{-2}$,
$$
\int_0^1(x-1/2)p(\theta(x))^2k_0(x)\,dx=0.
$$
dependencies.title: Conformal pressure moment identity

dependencies.statement:
Suppose the turn measure in @def-turn-measure has exactly one negative atom $-b$ at $0$, with $0<b<1/2$, and let $a$ be the turn weight at one of the two adjacent positive vertices. There is a choice of one adjacent edge on which $h=|F'|$ is monotone and, after orienting it decreasingly,
$$
\log h(\theta_-)-\log h(\theta_+)\ge c(a+b)
$$
on a central half of the edge.
dependencies.title: Monotone edge next to the unique reflex corner

Sort every defect you find into one of two kinds, because they are judged differently. A critical_error means the submission does not establish the target as written: a step that is wrong, invalid, or circular, a use of a dependency, definition, or hypothesis that does not actually apply, or a load-bearing part of the argument that is missing and cannot be routinely supplied. target.proof:
By @lem-reflex-monotone-edge, the selected adjacent edge has monotone $h$ and a central logarithmic drop at least $c(a+v)$. The elementary rectangle comparison in that lemma gives $D_I\ge c(a+v)$. By @lem-physical-pressure-moment, the edge moments give the centered condition in the normalized physical coordinate, and @lem-monotone-weight-comparison applies with $p_0=p_D/2$, $C_0=4$ once $S$ is sufficiently small. By @lem-edge-pressure-oscillation, $p_D/2\le p\le2p_D$ and therefore
$$
D_I\le C\operatorname{osc}_I p.
$$
Combining the two inequalities proves the result.
target.statement:
Let $P$ be an admissible stationary polygon with normalized conformal data in the small-$S$ regime of @lem-disk-perturbation, satisfying @lem-edge-moments. Suppose the turn measure in @def-turn-measure has exactly one negative atom $-v$ at a prevertex, with $0<v<1/2$, and let $a>0$ be one of the two adjacent positive atoms selected by the monotonicity sign. Then there is a corresponding effective edge arc $I$ such that
$$
c(a+v)\le D_I\le C\operatorname{osc}_I p,
$$
where
$$
D_I=\frac{\int_{s<t}(h(s)/h(t)-h(t)/h(s))\,dsdt}
{\int_{s<t}(h(s)/h(t)+h(t)/h(s))\,dsdt},
\qquad h=|F'|.
$$
target.title: One-reflex edge pressure comparison

critical_errors: From monotonicity and a central logarithmic drop \(L\ge c(a+v)\), one cannot conclude \(D_I\ge c(a+v)\) without an additional uniform upper bound on \(a+v\) and a proved quantitative rectangle estimate. Indeed \(0\le D_I<1\), whereas the supplied hypotheses impose no upper bound on \(a+v\); the natural consequence of a logarithmic drop saturates rather than grows linearly for large \(L\).
gaps: Applying @lem-monotone-weight-comparison with \(p_0=p_D/2\) requires explicitly establishing \(p_D>0\), and the conclusion \(D_I\le C\operatorname{osc}_I p\) requires that the factor \(1/p_D\) be uniformly absorbable into \(C\) by the normalization.
The proof should explicitly identify the comparison lemma's coordinate \(s(x)\) and weight \(\widetilde k_0(x)\) with the \(\theta(x)\) and \(k_0\) in @lem-physical-pressure-moment.
report.repair_hints: Supply a stated bound on the turn weights (in particular on \(a+v\)) and prove the rectangle estimate with constants, or weaken the lower bound to a saturating function such as \(c\min\{a+v,1\}\). Also state the positivity and uniform normalization of \(p_D\), and make the coordinate identification in the moment condition explicit.
report.summary: The proof does not establish the claimed linear lower bound for \(D_I\). The monotone-edge lemma supplies only a logarithmic drop, and the asserted rectangle comparison is neither stated nor sufficient for an unrestricted \(a+v\).
